rows.label: Vox Solaris
rows.note: Garuda Blueprint arrives as a separate inbox message once the quest ends

conditions: The main blueprint isn't the quest's on-screen reward — it's sent by Eudico's crew after the fact.
A lost blueprint costs 50,000 Cephalon Simaris standing to replace.

groups.activity: Conservation and bounties for Solaris United standing
conditions: Start this immediately — it's the actual bottleneck, not the bounty blueprints below.
Also buy the Sunpoint Plasma Drill (2,500 standing, no rank) or bring an Advanced Nosam Cutter; nothing mines the rare gems without one.
Marquise Thyst is Rank 4 only — players often farm all three part blueprints on day one, then discover Systems needs several more days of standing.
bonuses: Conservation with a Kubrodon lure and pheromones, or cave mining, is faster standing than regular bounties; hand raw gems and Debt-Bonds to Smokefinger and Ticker too.

disclosures.title: the rank-up cost was cut
disclosures.body: Debt-Bond sacrifices for Solaris rank-ups were rebalanced down; Rank 4 (Cove) now asks 5 Advance, 4 Medical and 3 Shelter Debt-Bonds, with earlier ranks needing fewer.

conditions: All three rotations (A, B, C) can drop every part — no need to wait for a specific rotation.
The Lvl 20-40 bounty is the hardest tier needed; nothing harder unlocks a better chance.

disclosures.title: stage math varies by source
disclosures.body: Community threads report higher final-stage odds (up to 27.6% for Chassis) with a lower chance on earlier stages; current wiki data lists flat per-mission odds instead. Either way the part can drop on any completed stage.

groups.sub: Spaceport, Enrichment Labs, Temple of Profit
groups.activity: farm bases for Toroids; mine and gather the rest

rows.label: Sola Toroid
rows.note: Temple of Profit enemies, Kyta Raknoids

rows.label: Star Amarast
rows.note: raw gem, blue veins near Temple of Profit

conditions: Each base drops only its own colour: Vega at the Spaceport, Calda at the Enrichment Labs, Sola at the Temple of Profit — regular enemies run about 2% base chance, boosted by drop-chance modifiers.
Rotate outside, then underground, then to the next base instead of waiting on max alert level; a cleared base respawns while you're elsewhere.
bonuses: Stack a Resource Drop Chance Booster, a relay Drop Chance Blessing, a Resource Booster and Resourceful Retriever — all apply to Toroid drops.
Once Rank 5 Solaris United and Profit-Taker are available, holding Phase 2 open keeps spawning Corpus dropships for Calda farming.
17 cave-interactable spots around the Vallis give common Toroids as a safe, low-yield top-up.
A loot frame (Nekros, Khora or Hydroid) with a high-Slash melee gibs bodies into more rolls.

disclosures.title: Toroids can vanish on long runs
disclosures.body: An unconfirmed bug thread reports hour-long hauls not being kept. Extract or finish cleanly rather than aborting, and check your inventory after long sessions.

conditions: The War Within must be finished first to unlock Kuva Siphons and Floods; without it, all three parts can be built with the main blueprint still stuck.
